# URN conformance table, shared verbatim by go-mhda
# (testdata/urn_conformance.txt) and the C++ port (tests/data/urn_conformance.txt).
# Both test suites run every row; an input one implementation refuses, the
# other refuses too, with the same error. Edit both copies together.
#
# Row forms:
#   accept urn <input URN> <canonical URN>
#   accept nss <input NSS> <canonical URN>
#   accept strict <input URN> <canonical URN>
#   refuse urn <error> <input URN>
#   refuse nss <error> <input NSS>
#   refuse strict <error> <input URN>
# urn rows use the lenient parser, strict rows ParseURNStrict /
# parse_urn_strict. <error> is the C++ error_code name; go-mhda maps it to
# its sentinel (invalid_nss is ErrInvalidNSS, incompatible is
# ErrIncompatible, ...).

# A derivation path needs a derivation type other than root. Without dt the
# address is root, and a dp there would be dropped: the URN would name the
# root key instead of the path it spells out.
refuse urn invalid_derivation_path urn:mhda:nt:evm:ci:1:dp:m/44'/60'/0'/0/0
refuse urn invalid_derivation_path urn:mhda:nt:evm:ci:1:dt:root:dp:m/0
refuse urn invalid_derivation_path urn:mhda:nt:evm:ci:1:dt:ROOT:dp:m/0
refuse urn invalid_derivation_path urn:mhda:nt:ton:ci:mainnet:dt:root:dp:m/44'/607'/0'
refuse urn invalid_derivation_path urn:mhda:dp:m/44'/60'/0'/0/0:nt:evm:ci:1
refuse nss invalid_derivation_path nt:evm:ci:1:dp:m/44'/60'/0'/0/0
refuse urn invalid_derivation_path urn:mhda:nt:evm:ci:1:dt:bip44
accept urn urn:mhda:nt:ton:ci:mainnet urn:mhda:nt:ton:ci:mainnet
accept urn urn:mhda:nt:evm:ci:1:dt:bip44:dp:m/44'/60'/0'/0/0 urn:mhda:nt:evm:ci:1:dt:bip44:dp:m/44'/60'/0'/0/0
accept nss nt:evm:ci:1:dt:bip44:dp:m/44'/60'/0'/0/0 urn:mhda:nt:evm:ci:1:dt:bip44:dp:m/44'/60'/0'/0/0

# The NSS is a sequence of key:value pairs. An unknown key is skipped
# together with its value (forward compatibility), so a following known key
# is never read as its value. A key that differs from a known key only by
# case is refused rather than skipped, and so is a token without a value.
refuse urn invalid_nss urn:mhda:nt:evm:ci:1:DT:bip44:DP:m/44'/60'/0'/0/5
refuse urn invalid_nss urn:mhda:nt:evm:ci:1:dt:bip44:dp:m/44'/60'/0'/0/0:WI:wallet-A
refuse urn invalid_nss urn:mhda:NT:evm:ci:1
refuse urn invalid_nss urn:mhda:nt:evm:Ci:1
accept urn urn:mhda:nt:evm:ci:1:ext:wi:dt:bip44:dp:m/44'/60'/0'/0/5 urn:mhda:nt:evm:ci:1:dt:bip44:dp:m/44'/60'/0'/0/5
accept urn urn:mhda:nt:evm:ci:1:xx:future urn:mhda:nt:evm:ci:1
accept urn urn:mhda:xx:nt:nt:evm:ci:1 urn:mhda:nt:evm:ci:1
refuse urn invalid_nss urn:mhda:nt:evm:ci:1:garbage
refuse urn invalid_nss urn:mhda:nt:evm:junk:ci:1
refuse urn invalid_nss urn:mhda:nt:evm:ci:1:
refuse urn invalid_nss urn:mhda::nt:evm:ci:1
refuse urn invalid_nss urn:mhda:nt:evm:ci:1::x
refuse urn invalid_nss urn:mhda:nt:evm:ci:1:xx:
refuse urn missing_network_type urn:mhda:
refuse nss invalid_nss nt:evm:ci:1:foo
accept nss nt:evm:ci:1:wt:web3 urn:mhda:nt:evm:ci:1:wt:web3

# '?' and '#' open the RFC 8141 r/q/f components. ParseURN strips them with
# everything after; an NSS passed on its own must not carry them in a value,
# or the URN emitted from it would be truncated on the next parse.
refuse nss invalid_nss nt:evm:ci:1?=q:dt:bip44:dp:m/44'/60'/0'/0/0
refuse nss invalid_nss nt:evm:ci:1#f
refuse nss invalid_nss nt:evm:ci:1:wi:a?b
refuse nss invalid_nss nt:evm:ci:1:x#y:z
accept urn urn:mhda:nt:evm:ci:1?=q:dt:bip44 urn:mhda:nt:evm:ci:1
accept urn urn:mhda:nt:evm:ci:1:dt:bip44:dp:m/44'/60'/0'/0/0#frag urn:mhda:nt:evm:ci:1:dt:bip44:dp:m/44'/60'/0'/0/0

# Root is the default derivation type and carries no path: an explicit
# dt:root is folded away, so a root address has one canonical form.
accept urn urn:mhda:nt:ton:ci:mainnet:dt:root urn:mhda:nt:ton:ci:mainnet
accept urn urn:mhda:nt:algorand:ci:mainnet:ct:283:dt:root:af:base32 urn:mhda:nt:algorand:ci:mainnet:ct:283:af:base32
accept urn urn:mhda:nt:evm:ci:1:dt:ROOT urn:mhda:nt:evm:ci:1

# Strict mode and the curves. SLIP-10 derives ed25519 keys through hardened
# levels only, so every level of an ed25519 path must be hardened; cip1852
# (BIP32-Ed25519) is the one ed25519 scheme with soft levels. The lenient
# parser still accepts these paths.
refuse strict incompatible urn:mhda:nt:solana:ci:mainnet:dt:slip10:dp:m/44'/501'/0/0
refuse strict incompatible urn:mhda:nt:solana:ci:mainnet:dt:slip10:dp:m/44'/501'/0'/0'/7
refuse strict incompatible urn:mhda:nt:stellar:ci:pubnet:dt:slip10:dp:m/44'/148'/0
refuse strict incompatible urn:mhda:nt:ton:ci:mainnet:dt:slip10:dp:m/44'/607'/0'/0'/0
refuse strict incompatible urn:mhda:nt:cosmos:ci:secret:dt:bip44:dp:m/44'/529'/0'/0/0:aa:ed25519
refuse strict incompatible urn:mhda:nt:xrpl:ci:mainnet:dt:bip44:dp:m/44'/144'/0'/0/0:aa:ed25519
accept urn urn:mhda:nt:solana:ci:mainnet:dt:slip10:dp:m/44'/501'/0/0 urn:mhda:nt:solana:ci:mainnet:dt:slip10:dp:m/44'/501'/0/0
accept strict urn:mhda:nt:solana:ci:mainnet:dt:slip10:dp:m/44'/501'/0'/0' urn:mhda:nt:solana:ci:mainnet:dt:slip10:dp:m/44'/501'/0'/0'
accept strict urn:mhda:nt:stellar:ci:pubnet:dt:slip10:dp:m/44'/148'/0' urn:mhda:nt:stellar:ci:pubnet:dt:slip10:dp:m/44'/148'/0'
accept strict urn:mhda:nt:ton:ci:mainnet:dt:slip10:dp:m/44'/607'/0' urn:mhda:nt:ton:ci:mainnet:dt:slip10:dp:m/44'/607'/0'
accept strict urn:mhda:nt:cardano:ci:mainnet:dt:cip1852:dp:m/1852'/1815'/0'/0/0 urn:mhda:nt:cardano:ci:mainnet:dt:cip1852:dp:m/1852'/1815'/0'/0/0
accept strict urn:mhda:nt:xrpl:ci:mainnet:dt:bip44:dp:m/44'/144'/0'/0/0 urn:mhda:nt:xrpl:ci:mainnet:dt:bip44:dp:m/44'/144'/0'/0/0

# Sui encodes the signature scheme in the purpose (bip54 secp256k1, bip74
# secp256r1, slip10 ed25519); Aptos and NEAR derive ed25519 through slip10
# and secp256k1 through bip44. A derivation type takes only its own curve.
refuse strict incompatible urn:mhda:nt:sui:ci:mainnet:dt:bip54:dp:m/54'/784'/0'/0/0
refuse strict incompatible urn:mhda:nt:sui:ci:mainnet:dt:bip54:dp:m/54'/784'/0'/0/0:aa:secp256r1
refuse strict incompatible urn:mhda:nt:sui:ci:mainnet:dt:bip74:dp:m/74'/784'/0'/0/0:aa:secp256k1
refuse strict incompatible urn:mhda:nt:sui:ci:mainnet:dt:slip10:dp:m/44'/784'/0'/0'/0':aa:secp256k1
refuse strict incompatible urn:mhda:nt:aptos:ci:mainnet:dt:bip44:dp:m/44'/637'/0'/0/0
refuse strict incompatible urn:mhda:nt:aptos:ci:mainnet:dt:slip10:dp:m/44'/637'/0'/0'/0':aa:secp256k1
refuse strict incompatible urn:mhda:nt:near:ci:mainnet:dt:bip44:dp:m/44'/397'/0'/0/0
accept strict urn:mhda:nt:sui:ci:mainnet:dt:bip54:dp:m/54'/784'/0'/0/0:aa:secp256k1 urn:mhda:nt:sui:ci:mainnet:dt:bip54:dp:m/54'/784'/0'/0/0:aa:secp256k1
accept strict urn:mhda:nt:sui:ci:mainnet:dt:bip74:dp:m/74'/784'/0'/0/0:aa:secp256r1 urn:mhda:nt:sui:ci:mainnet:dt:bip74:dp:m/74'/784'/0'/0/0:aa:secp256r1
accept strict urn:mhda:nt:sui:ci:mainnet:dt:slip10:dp:m/44'/784'/0'/0'/0' urn:mhda:nt:sui:ci:mainnet:dt:slip10:dp:m/44'/784'/0'/0'/0'
accept strict urn:mhda:nt:aptos:ci:mainnet:dt:bip44:dp:m/44'/637'/0'/0/0:aa:secp256k1 urn:mhda:nt:aptos:ci:mainnet:dt:bip44:dp:m/44'/637'/0'/0/0:aa:secp256k1
accept strict urn:mhda:nt:aptos:ci:mainnet:dt:slip10:dp:m/44'/637'/0'/0'/0' urn:mhda:nt:aptos:ci:mainnet:dt:slip10:dp:m/44'/637'/0'/0'/0'
accept strict urn:mhda:nt:near:ci:mainnet:dt:bip44:dp:m/44'/397'/0'/0/1:aa:secp256k1 urn:mhda:nt:near:ci:mainnet:dt:bip44:dp:m/44'/397'/0'/0/1:aa:secp256k1
accept strict urn:mhda:nt:near:ci:mainnet:dt:slip10:dp:m/44'/397'/0' urn:mhda:nt:near:ci:mainnet:dt:slip10:dp:m/44'/397'/0'

# Bitcoin: the purpose defines the script, so an explicit af must match it
# (bip44 p2pkh, bip49 p2sh, bip84 p2wpkh or bech32, bip86 p2tr or bech32m;
# bip32 takes any). Without af the URN stays valid.
refuse strict incompatible urn:mhda:nt:bitcoin:ci:bitcoin:dt:bip84:dp:m/84'/0'/0'/0/0:af:p2pkh
refuse strict incompatible urn:mhda:nt:bitcoin:ci:bitcoin:dt:bip44:dp:m/44'/0'/0'/0/0:af:p2wpkh
refuse strict incompatible urn:mhda:nt:bitcoin:ci:bitcoin:dt:bip49:dp:m/49'/0'/0'/0/0:af:p2wpkh
refuse strict incompatible urn:mhda:nt:bitcoin:ci:bitcoin:dt:bip86:dp:m/86'/0'/0'/0/0:af:bech32
accept strict urn:mhda:nt:bitcoin:ci:bitcoin:dt:bip84:dp:m/84'/0'/0'/0/0 urn:mhda:nt:bitcoin:ci:bitcoin:dt:bip84:dp:m/84'/0'/0'/0/0
accept strict urn:mhda:nt:bitcoin:ci:bitcoin:dt:bip84:dp:m/84'/0'/0'/0/0:af:p2wpkh urn:mhda:nt:bitcoin:ci:bitcoin:dt:bip84:dp:m/84'/0'/0'/0/0:af:p2wpkh
accept strict urn:mhda:nt:bitcoin:ci:bitcoin:dt:bip84:dp:m/84'/0'/0'/0/0:af:bech32 urn:mhda:nt:bitcoin:ci:bitcoin:dt:bip84:dp:m/84'/0'/0'/0/0:af:bech32
accept strict urn:mhda:nt:bitcoin:ci:bitcoin:dt:bip86:dp:m/86'/0'/0'/0/0:af:p2tr urn:mhda:nt:bitcoin:ci:bitcoin:dt:bip86:dp:m/86'/0'/0'/0/0:af:p2tr
accept strict urn:mhda:nt:bitcoin:ci:bitcoin:dt:bip86:dp:m/86'/0'/0'/0/0:af:bech32m urn:mhda:nt:bitcoin:ci:bitcoin:dt:bip86:dp:m/86'/0'/0'/0/0:af:bech32m
accept strict urn:mhda:nt:bitcoin:ci:bitcoin:dt:bip49:dp:m/49'/0'/0'/0/0:af:p2sh urn:mhda:nt:bitcoin:ci:bitcoin:dt:bip49:dp:m/49'/0'/0'/0/0:af:p2sh
accept strict urn:mhda:nt:bitcoin:ci:bitcoin:dt:bip44:dp:m/44'/0'/0'/0/0:af:p2pkh urn:mhda:nt:bitcoin:ci:bitcoin:dt:bip44:dp:m/44'/0'/0'/0/0:af:p2pkh
accept strict urn:mhda:nt:bitcoin:ci:bitcoin:dt:bip32:dp:m/0'/0/0:af:p2wpkh urn:mhda:nt:bitcoin:ci:bitcoin:dt:bip32:dp:m/0'/0/0:af:p2wpkh

# Cosmos: bip44 with coin 118' is the cip11 path m/44'/118'/... (one key,
# two spellings); strict mode keeps cip11. bip44 with another coin stays.
refuse strict incompatible urn:mhda:nt:cosmos:ci:cosmoshub:dt:bip44:dp:m/44'/118'/0'/0/0
accept strict urn:mhda:nt:cosmos:ci:cosmoshub:dt:cip11:dp:m/44'/118'/0'/0/0 urn:mhda:nt:cosmos:ci:cosmoshub:dt:cip11:dp:m/44'/118'/0'/0/0
accept strict urn:mhda:nt:cosmos:ci:secret:dt:bip44:dp:m/44'/529'/0'/0/0 urn:mhda:nt:cosmos:ci:secret:dt:bip44:dp:m/44'/529'/0'/0/0

# NSS bytes are RFC 3986 pchar or "/": letters, digits and -._~!$&'()*+,;=@/,
# except ':' (the component separator) and '%' (percent-encoding is not
# supported, and a raw %41 would be a second spelling of "A"). The other
# printable ASCII bytes cannot appear in a URN at all.
refuse urn invalid_nss urn:mhda:nt:evm:ci:a"b
refuse urn invalid_nss urn:mhda:nt:evm:ci:a<b
refuse urn invalid_nss urn:mhda:nt:evm:ci:a>b
refuse urn invalid_nss urn:mhda:nt:evm:ci:a\b
refuse urn invalid_nss urn:mhda:nt:evm:ci:a^b
refuse urn invalid_nss urn:mhda:nt:evm:ci:a`b
refuse urn invalid_nss urn:mhda:nt:evm:ci:a{b
refuse urn invalid_nss urn:mhda:nt:evm:ci:a|b
refuse urn invalid_nss urn:mhda:nt:evm:ci:a}b
refuse urn invalid_nss urn:mhda:nt:evm:ci:a[b
refuse urn invalid_nss urn:mhda:nt:evm:ci:a]b
refuse urn invalid_nss urn:mhda:nt:evm:ci:a%41
refuse urn invalid_nss urn:mhda:nt:evm:ci:1:wi:x|y
refuse urn invalid_nss urn:mhda:nt:evm:ci:1:x|y:z
accept urn urn:mhda:nt:evm:ci:a-b.c_d~e!f$g&h'i(j)k*l+m,n;o=p@q/r urn:mhda:nt:evm:ci:a-b.c_d~e!f$g&h'i(j)k*l+m,n;o=p@q/r
accept urn urn:mhda:nt:cosmos:ci:cosmoshub-4:ap:X-avax:wi:c0a8f2d4-3b6e urn:mhda:nt:cosmos:ci:cosmoshub-4:ap:X-avax:wi:c0a8f2d4-3b6e
